title: Master Equation Span Judgment Rubric

span_roles.meaning: The span states or proposes what plays a Master Equation slot role (G, M, E, S_eff, T, K, R, Q, F, C), or makes a claim about a slot's behavior.
The span engages the product test: whether removing or zeroing one ingredient collapses the whole (multiplicative) or only weakens it (additive), thresholds, zero-collapse, veto.
The span rates or discusses how something maps onto the Master Equation: direct, analogous, stretched, or absent.
The span defines a term, symbol, factor, or concept.
The span states or implies a falsification or kill condition: what would show the claim is wrong.
The span offers evidence, observation, derivation, or citation in support of a claim.
The span explains how something works: the mechanism, not the claim or the evidence.
Everything else: framing, story, exhortation, transition, style.

slots.name: External Negentropy Influx
slots.definition: Coherence cannot be self-sufficient in a closed system; it needs an outside influx.

slots.name: Alignment Cosine
slots.definition: Coupling is strongest when the system is aligned with its reference.

slots.name: Signal Propagation Fidelity
slots.definition: Whether truth survives transmission through noise.

slots.name: Effective Entropy Factor
slots.definition: Entropy enters as what lowers the coherence contribution.

slots.name: Temporal Integration
slots.definition: Time turns possibility into accumulated consequence.

slots.name: Information Compression Ratio
slots.definition: Ordered meaning compresses and noise does not.

slots.name: Phase Transition Indicator
slots.definition: Some thresholds change state, not just degree.

slots.name: Superposition Measure
slots.definition: Open possibility stays unresolved until actualized.

slots.name: Non-Local Correlation Strength
slots.definition: Related systems are no longer independent.

slots.name: Total Integration Measure
slots.definition: The local integrator inside the product.

canon_conditions.meaning: The claim carries no canonical address (no unique ID, no one home). Flag when the span's claim could not be entered into a ledger as stated.

The claim uses a grade or status label outside the ruled vocabulary (LOCKED, DERIVED, CANDIDATE; lifecycle INTAKE, OPENING, REVIEW, FROZEN, ADMITTED). Flag when the span invents its own status language.
The claim asserts proof, derivation, or formal verification, but no recorded receipt is cited. Flag when 'proven/derived/verified' language appears with no receipt pointer.
The claim asserts canonicity (canonical, locked, ratified) but cites no ruling. Flag when canonicity is claimed with no ruling citation (a canonical ruling line, a ratification, a dated ruling).
The span contradicts another claim's slot assignment or a protected marker. Flag when the span collides with canon rather than fitting it.

kill_condition_rule: When a span states or implies a falsification or kill condition (what would show the claim wrong), capture it verbatim in kill_condition. Empty string when the span carries none.
grading_note: Grade OBSERVABLE TEXT ONLY. Quotes must be verbatim substrings of the span. Where evidence is missing, say so. Never invent precision.
